hotel_name: The Hythe , A Luxury Collection Resort

claims.text: The accommodations are scented with sweet spruce and fir aromatherapies.

findings.quote: Fragrant with sweet spruce and fir aromatherapies, The Hythe’s elegant accommodations extend a sense of calm

claims.text: Most rooms have fireplaces and mountain views.

findings.quote: Most rooms have fireplaces and mountain views

claims.text: All rooms have design details that nod to the area's history, including framed 10th Mountain Division pins.

findings.quote: all feature design details that nod to the area’s history, including framed 10th Mountain Division pins.

claims.text: The resort offers residences and penthouses where family and friends can relax together.

findings.quote: Experience alpine resort living in our Residences and Penthouses, as you serve dinner and drinks with flair, or relax with family and friends in a space that revolves around you.

claims.text: The Well & Being Spa offers an Apothecary experience where guests create custom-blended essential oils.

findings.quote: The signature Well & Being Spa is home to a curated Recovery Lounge and recovery-focused set of offerings, including Vail’s only Himalayan Salt Therapy Lounge and an exclusive Apothecary experience to create custom-blended essential oils.

claims.text: Guests coming from sea level can book an oxygen therapy session at the spa to help acclimate to the altitude.

findings.quote: If you’re coming from sea level, book an oxygen therapy session to help acclimate to the altitude

claims.text: The spa's self-care lounge has Hyperice massage guns and Normatec leg compression sleeves for sore muscles.

findings.quote: pop into the self-care lounge and soothe sore muscles with Hyperice massage guns and Normatec leg compression sleeves

claims.text: The resort has a four-season pool.

findings.quote: 29,000 square feet of unparalleled event space and a four-season pool

claims.text: A massive, glass-enclosed fireplace anchors the hotel lobby.

findings.quote: A massive, glass-enclosed fireplace anchors the hotel lobby

claims.text: A hallway off the lobby shows a rotating selection of local art, and beyond it is a room of vintage photographs from the 10th Mountain Division and the golden age of skiing.

findings.quote: Just off the lobby you’ll find a hallway showcasing a rotating selection of local art, and beyond that is a room full of vintage photographs from the 10th Mountain Division and golden age of skiing.

claims.text: Margie's Haas is a tribute to Margie Haas, a World War II local home cook who welcomed 10th Mountain Division soldiers into her home.

findings.quote: Margie’s Haas breakfast is a tribute to the World War II local home cook, Margie Haas, who welcomed soldiers from the 10th Mountain Division into her home.

claims.text: The lobby bar serves Colorado-crafted whiskey and spirits in partnership with the local distillery 10th Mountain Whiskey & Spirit Company.

findings.quote: savor Colorado-crafted whiskey and spirits from our lobby bar in Vail, CO, in partnership with 10th Mountain Whiskey & Spirit Company, a local distillery.

claims.text: Design, decor and dining pay homage to Vail founders Earl Eaton and Pete Seibert and the mountain's 1960s heyday.

findings.quote: Design, decor, and dining pay homage to Vail founders Earl Eaton and Pete Seibert and the mountain’s 1960s heyday.

claims.text: The resort has easy access to the Eagle Bahn Gondola, Lionshead Village and Betty Ford Alpine Village.

findings.quote: with easy access to the Eagle Bahn Gondola, Lionshead Village and Betty Ford Alpine Village.

claims.text: Suites have whirlpool jet bathtubs and two balconies with mountain views.

findings.quote: Luxe suites boast whirlpool jet bathtubs and two balconies showcasing spectacular mountain views.

claims.text: The spa has a Himalayan salt lounge guests can enjoy before their treatments.

findings.quote: Arrive early to take advantage of the Himalayan salt lounge

claims.text: Complimentary daily moments include fireside s'mores and tastings of locally distilled 10th Mountain Whiskey.

findings.quote: Enjoy our complimentary daily epicurean moments, including fireside s’mores and tastings of locally distilled 10th Mountain Whiskey.

claims.text: Entry-level rooms are about 300 square feet, so guests who want more space should consider an upgrade.

findings.quote: Entry-level rooms span just 300 square feet, so if you crave space, it’s worth upgrading.

claims.text: The rooms do not have a work space.

findings.quote: No, the rooms at The Hythe, a Luxury Collection Resort, Vail do not have a work space.

claims.text: Pets are limited to two dogs per room and are not permitted in private residences.

findings.quote: for maximum 2 pets per room – dogs only.
Pets are not permitted in private residences.
